messages:
devon: Heads up — seeing NCCL hangs / stalled allreduce on 8xA100 jobs in us-west-2 after last infra config push. 3 clusters, same pattern.

infra-bot: deploy:config-update to us-west-2 completed at 2026-02-24T18:02:30Z (id: cfg-20260224-18).

chao: Can you paste the job logs? is this only on Dedicated pools or Hosted VMs too?

devon: Dedicated GPU pools only (g5-reserve-usw2). Quick excerpt:
```
NCCL WARN Call to ncclCommInitRank failed : Unrecoverable error
[2026-02-24 17:58:12] rdma_cm: connect() failed (110) - Connection timed out
[2026-02-24 17:58:12] ibv_poll_cq returned error 5
```

marya: That rdma_cm timeout smells like RoCE path issues. Any MTU differences between leafs/spines?

devon: I ran basic checks on one affected host:
```
$ ip link show eth0
2: eth0: mtu 1500 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
$ ethtool -k eth0
rx-checksumming: on
large-receive-offload: off
```
But switch config from last night shows MTU 9216 on some leafs and 1500 on the new spine patch.
messages_addendum:
anita: ok that's a classic MTU/path-mismatch for RoCEv2 -> fragments or PMTU blackholing. Packets get fragmented then RDMA/UDP drops them.

chao: Can we verify the ib devices?

devon: ran these on node-17: 
```
$ ibv_devinfo -v
hca_id: mlx5_0
fw_ver: 16.35.0
max_mr_size: 0x7fffffffffff
link_layer: ETH
port 1: state: PORT_ACTIVE (4)
```
But ibv devices show port active. However tcpdump on eth0 shows many ICMP 'fragmentation needed' messages and some UDP retransmits.

marya: Try forcing traffic with ibv_rc_pingpong or ib_send_bw to confirm path behavior. Also run `tcpdump -i eth0 -vv 'icmp and ip[20]=3'` to catch PMTU ICMP type 3 code 4.

devon: Did an ib_send_bw test between two GPUs (host-to-host) and saw large send failures until I lowered MPI_NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME and set MTU 1500 across path. With MTU 1500 everything passes.

anita: So fix is either normalize MTU to 9216 everywhere or set 1500 everywhere. Given other tenants rely on jumbo, I'd prefer to fix the one spine that got defaulted to 1500.

chao: Agree. Which switch got the bad config? showing: sw-usw2-spine-3 got factory default applied during maintenance window.

infra-bot: incident created #INC-2026-1127 (title: RoCE path-mtu mismatch in us-west-2).

devon: Plan: 1) push correct MTU 9216 to sw-usw2-spine-3 and adjacent leafs, 2) drain affected hosts in pool, 3) run ib_send_bw and NCCL sample job with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO, 4) monitor.

marya: Also add a preflight check in the provisioning playbook that verifies `ip link` MTU and `ethtool -k` LRO/GSO/TSO settings match expected values for RoCE (LR0/LRO off, GSO/TCP off where needed).

anita: Can someone own the sw change and the runbook updates? I can do runbook. devon can own switch change + test. chao will validate kernel/driver bits.

devon: On it. I'll schedule a quiet window and patch spine-3 now. Posting updates here. :thumbsup:
